ValidationRule.description: This rule will fire for Quality Cases only when Case has High or Very High priority and consumer is not linked or Phone or email is missing for that consumer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'NA_Quality', NOT( OR( $Profile.Name ='System Administrator', $Profile.Name = 'Nexus Data Loader' ) ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Priority , 'High'), ISPICKVAL( Priority , 'Very High') ), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), AND( Account.PersonEmail = null, OR( Account.Primary_Phone__c = null, CONTAINS("na:NA:nA:Na", Account.Primary_Phone__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Priority should be kept as Medium if no consumer is linked or primary phone, email address and last name are missing in Consumer details.
